scope: Keep the dragged panel active when ungrouping either dock from a desktop tabbed group to either canvas edge across every supported saved dock order and group side.

gap_and_fix.verified_gap: Ungrouping a dock calls setDockLayout, which reapplies the balanced visual preset. Applying that preset opens the left dock and then the right dock, so the dragged left dock loses active selection and the right Inspector is selected instead.
gap_and_fix.red_reproduction: Real Chromium matrix failed at left-canvas-right / left-side tab group / left dock / before-canvas edge: active panel was right although the left panel was selected before dragging.
gap_and_fix.fix: After a successful tabbed-to-separate drop, explicitly select/open the dragged source dock in the shell state. This mirrors the existing group-drop behavior and does not create another workspace history entry. Cache-busted shell URL is 20261105-tabbed-ungroup-active-dock.
contracts: The dragged panel stays the active panel after separation.
Undo restores the prior tabbed mode, side, and dock order as one workspace step.
All six saved dock orders and both group sides preserve the selected canvas edge.
The canvas remains at least 400 CSS px and neither dock overlaps it.
The operation is workspace-only and does not invoke Page Model, Save, Publish, or renderer writes.

assertions: drop preview identifies the selected canvas edge
tabbed mode becomes separate while remembered group side is retained
dropped source dock remains active before and after the operation
minimum canvas is 400 CSS px and neither dock rectangle overlaps it
drop lifecycle closes and one Undo restores the grouped mode, side, and prior order
Undo restores the selected source dock
